SR_NORMAL.label: 正常运行
SR_NORMAL.scope: 旧单柜 SR_NORMAL 工程研究。未标定约简回路，不是当前00/01设计结果或现场测量。

input.actuator: exact unmodified tracking-profile lag1s/ramp0.2 per s/delay0.2s/bounds0.3..0.9; engineering integration, not new formal qualification
input.controller_note: new numerical pump-demand feedback on measured rack return-minus-inlet; 8K is an excitation/control assumption, NOT final return temperature or 45C thermal criterion
input.faults: STUCK holds actual speed from10s without PLC fault bit; MISSING invalid samples from20s; STALE stops samples from20s; PRIMARY_WARM raises external primary boundary by4K from20s
input.hydraulics: single document rack budget171.63kPa plus10kPa bench series allowance; six complete371.81kPa HOT/219.73kPa NORMAL budget; equal-share branch reference and quadratic synthetic pump curve; no absolute pressures/NPSH claim
input.initial_return_note: initial supply plus design IT enthalpy rise at initial load/actual initial flow; declared initial condition, not resetting temperatures each step
input.inventories: single supply0.02+rack0.05+return0.02m3; six supply0.1+racks6x0.05+return0.1m3; factor0.5/2 sensitivity; NOT measured geometry
input.numeric_tolerances: local independent gamma4096*u; global gamma8192*(steps+1)*u, u=2^-53, scaled by stored energy and ledger; hydraulic gamma4096; no fitted thermal success tolerance
input.pump_loss_partition: all electrical input to liquid once; no measured motor/VFD heat partition claim
input.single_rack_boundary: engineering recirculation/HX bench: primary41/37C,18.333m3/h and UA36.667kW/K are explicit scaled sensitivity boundaries, NOT a final selected single-rack CDU
input.six_rack_boundary: primary41/37C at110m3/h final design; UA220kW/K sensitivity, not manufacturer map;1100kW selection not injected heat or hard cooling cap
